import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem conjugation_restriction_unique_exponent {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (hG : ∀ (H : Subgroup G), H.Normal)
  (a : G)
  (hinf : ∀ n : ℤ, a ^ n = 1 → n = 0)
  (b : G) :
  ∃! j : ℤ,
    ∃ f : Subgroup.zpowers a ≃* Subgroup.zpowers a,
      f ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ =
        ⟨a ^ j, Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩ ∧
      ∀ x : Subgroup.zpowers a, (f x : G) = b * x * b⁻¹ := by
  let H := Subgroup.zpowers a
  have hH : H.Normal := hG H
  have hconj : ∀ x : G, x ∈ H → ∀ g : G, g * x * g⁻¹ ∈ H := fun x hx g => hH.conj_mem x hx g
  have h_ba : b * a * b⁻¹ ∈ H := hconj a (Subgroup.mem_zpowers a) b
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp h_ba
  use j
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hf_toFun : ∀ x : H, b * (x : G) * b⁻¹ ∈ H := fun x => hconj x.1 x.2 b
    have hf_invFun : ∀ y : H, b⁻¹ * (y : G) * (b⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H := fun y => hconj y.1 y.2 b⁻¹
    let f : H ≃* H :=
      { toFun := fun x => ⟨b * x.1 * b⁻¹, hf_toFun x⟩
        invFun := fun y => ⟨b⁻¹ * y.1 * b, by
          simpa using hf_invFun y⟩
        left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (by simp [mul_assoc])
        right_inv := fun y => Subtype.ext (by simp [mul_assoc])
        map_mul' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (by simp [mul_assoc]) }
    refine ⟨f, ?_, fun x => rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hj.symm
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨f, hf1, hf2⟩
    have h1 : (f ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : G) = a ^ y := by
      rw [hf1]
    have h2 : (f ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : G) = b * a * b⁻¹ := hf2 ⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩
    have heq : a ^ y = a ^ j := by
      rw [← h1, h2, ← hj]
    have hdiv : a ^ (y - j) = 1 := by
      rw [zpow_sub, heq, mul_inv_cancel]
    have hyj : y - j = 0 := hinf (y - j) hdiv
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hyj
